item.title: World reacts to AfD victory in east Germany state election
item.description: French minister calls AfD's victory a grave moment, warning of growing nationalism and its impact on European unity.

item.title: Video: Israeli air strikes kill at least 10 in southern Lebanon
item.description: Israeli air strikes on southern Lebanon began at dawn on Sunday, killing at least 10 people.

item.title: Iran war: How US consumers spent an additional $100bn on fuel
item.description: The average US household has spent $763 extra on fuel in six months, as the US-Israel war on Iran pushes up fuel costs.

item.title: Fire breaks out at Chile ski resort
item.description: A fire broke out at a ski resort in Chile’s mountainous Nuble region.

item.title: Nepal holds day of mourning for more than 1,300 killed in floods
item.description: Nepal flags fly at half-mast to mark a day of mourning after catastrophic Himalayan floods kill more than 1,300.

item.title: Arsenal vs Chelsea: Gunners stamp authority, but Blues are contenders too
item.description: Arsenal's strong defence and reliable attack edge Chelsea's bravery and intent in the Premier League's biggest clash.

item.title: Israeli forces kill Palestinian suspect after settler stabbed in West Bank
item.description: The stabbing follows a wave of pogroms against Palestinians in the occupied West Bank by Israeli settlers.

item.title: India teams search for survivors after Delhi building collapse kills six
item.description: Rescue teams work to locate survivors after New Delhi building collapse.

item.title: Israeli air attacks kill at least 11 people in southern Lebanon
item.description: Israeli air strike on residential building in Kfar Reman kills nine people, and two medics killed in drone attack.

item.title: Six children among 11 people killed in Indonesian market fire
item.description: A massive fire at a market in the Indonesia village of Babuda has claimed the lives of eleven people.

item.title: Ten killed and dozens injured in Mexico fireworks blast
item.description: Ten people were killed after a fireworks display detonated during a religious festival in Mexico, injuring dozens more.

item.title: Anti-immigration protesters clash with police in UK after boat arrival
item.description: Anti-immigration protesters clashed with police in Portsmouth after around 140 people arrived in UK aboard a small boat.

item.title: Armed assailant attacks Ohio Democratic candidate during campaign stop
item.description: Patrick Havas, 38, arrested with weapons after injuring several at Ohio Democrat Amy Acton’s campaign stop.

item.title: Philippines warns China may reassert itself amid US-South Korea drill cuts
item.description: Manila defence chief says Washington gave 'definite assurances' that its commitments to the Philippines remain.

item.title: Iran to announce restricted zone outside Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Iran's security chief Mohsen Rezaei says Tehran will announce a restricted zone around the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Australia’s proposed ‘opt out’ law targets Big Tech algorithms
item.description: Social media platforms face scrutiny over addictive algorithms; new law aims to give Australians greater feed control.

item.title: Eight-year-old Gaza girl killed by Israel on first day of school
item.description: An eight-year-old girl and her father were killed when an Israeli strike hit their vehicle on her first day of school.

item.title: Adidas faces boycott over amputee campaign featuring Israeli soldier
item.description: Adidas is facing calls for a boycott after featuring a former Israeli soldier in a campaign for amputees.

item.title: Jamaica to file slavery reparations petition during UK visit
item.description: Petition to King Charles questions the legality of slavery under English law and UK’s responsibility for reparations.

item.title: Why is Kenya cracking down on foreign traders and small retailers?
item.description: President Ruto says small businesses should be reserved for Kenyans as his government moves against foreign traders.

item.title: Serbia’s Red Star Belgrade honour Ratko Mladic with tifo
item.description: Red Star Belgrade fans unveiled a tifo honouring Ratko Mladic at the Belgrade derby with Partizan.

item.title: North Korea deploys warship ‘capable of annihilating retaliatory strikes’
item.description: Leader Kim Jong Un says vessel will form part of Pyongyang's nuclear response system, strengthen naval forces.

item.title: Iran war live: US energy firms ‘legitimate’ targets after tanker attacks
item.description: Iran's top negotiator warns US oil-and-gas companies will be hit after Hormuz Strait shipping strikes.

item.title: Alcaraz breezes into last eight at US Open
item.description: Carlos Alcaraz beats American Tommy Paul in straight sets to reach US Open quarterfinals.

item.title: At least five killed after Amazon cargo plane crash in Miami airport
item.description: Five people are injured, and the cause of the crash is being investigated, authorities say.
